clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Amos's death in July 1989, within the following months: your mother's worry over money starting in March 1988, her move to avoid talking with your father about it in May 1988, your brother Felix's grades falling in November 1989, and your mother calmer once back at work in March 1990.
